## What

<!-- What does this change do? Name the parts of the app it touches. -->

## Why

<!-- What problem does it solve? Link the related issue, for example "Fixes #123". -->

## How

<!-- How have you solved this issue? List specific changes and updates with references to the code. -->

## Testing

<!--
Confirm changes were tested. Name the new or changed tests, and say whether they fail without this change. 

If you didn't add tests, say why.
-->

## Screenshots

<!-- For interface changes, add screenshots or a short recording. Otherwise delete this section. -->

## Notes for reviewers

<!-- Anything to look at closely, trade-offs you made, or follow-up work you've left out. -->

## Checklist

- [ ] `php artisan test --compact` passes
- [ ] `vendor/bin/pint --dirty` has been run
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has tests
- [ ] New translation strings are in `lang/` 
- [ ] Docs, `README.md`, and `openapi.json` are updated if the change affects users or the API
- [ ] I've tried the change in the browser, if it touches the UI
